question: Why doesn't this Effect re-run when inputRef.current changes?
options: Refs are always null in Effects
say: Why does this Effect not re-run when input ref dot current changes?
explanation: ref.current is mutable and not reactive. Changing it triggers no re-render, so React never re-checks the dependencies.
explainSay: Changing ref dot current does not cause a re-render, so React never re-checks it.
